about: The golden vectors of anet 0.3.0 (ANetCore v0.16): for each vector, its files, the labels (wire/registry.json tags, by id) and objects it covers, the area that owns it and what produces its bytes. golden/index_test.go checks this index against the registry and the repositories; golden/py/gen_v016.py check (CI golden-xcheck) regenerates every vector it writes and compares the bytes. An artifact with "todo" is not delivered yet and must not exist; one with "rework" exists in its v0.2 form and is still to be rewritten; remove the marker in the change that delivers it.
seeds: every random input of a vector is SHA-256("anet-golden/v016/<vector id>/<role>")

gens.python: gen_v016.py seals or writes the bytes; the Go test opens them and reproduces every derived value
gens.go+python: gen_v016.py writes the file; the Go test reproduces every value from the same seeds
gens.go: the Go test holds or writes the vector; golden-xcheck does not regenerate it
gens.rfc: values transcribed from an RFC; gen_v016.py regenerates them from the RFC's inputs
gens.a2a-python: written by a2acard/testdata/gen_python_vectors.py with the a2a-python SDK; golden-xcheck does not run it

vectors.covers: single layer: outer v2 with key 7 of kind 0; Wrap (keys 3, 21); inner with keys 10, 11, 12, 14, 15; preimage v2 (keys 33, 34 null, key 9 a digest); signature; env_digest; ack_key, handle, tok

two layers; ikid; preimage keys 33, 34 set; outer key 7 of kind 1 (Cap and proof), outer key 8, an extension key >= 64 in the outer and in the inner; a second implementation derives both keys from the seeds and opens the same bytes; layer-1 ack_key equal to the single-layer export of the same outer; handle and tok; a changed layer-2 byte, a dropped enc2, an unregistered Wrap key

negatives, each with its seal reason: second layer stripped, enc2 replaced, one layer moved under a second, a second layer to a key no longer held, a changed layer-2 byte, a second layer under the key of another interaction or peer, rk of suite 2, Wrap with unknown key 5, pad not zero, inner key 21, inner key 0 or 30, outer key 9, access kind 2, outer and inner exp unequal, v = 1, key 11 without key 10, KEL v1, a ReceiptBody signature over the inner preimage, inner ix or from with U+0000
the inner of a preview frame: no keys 10, 11, 12, 14; key 15 present; outer key 8 = inner ts + 60000
CapBody and Cap bytes and signature; the holder proof; each failing step of VerifyAccess (owner is not to, wrong epoch, expired, wrong holder, access moved to another envelope)
a Grant with every field and with the fewest; each failing check of CheckGrant
15 epoch keys and mbox; VerifyEncKeySet on the day, on day 14 and on day 15; a set without mbox
from SEALED-2A and SEALED-2B: ack_key, handle, tok(1), tok(2), note_key; notes under a fixed nonce (outcome 1 empty, busy 30 s, caller_busy, quota_caller_per_day); a whole dack
RFC 9180 Appendix A.2.1 (suite 1); the three exports of the appendix are still to be added
a hub identity (toad = 0): icp, rot 1 (setup-recovery), rot 2 (emergency), dip 3; each event's preimage, event id and signature
an agent identity (toad = 1): icp (witness pending), rot 1 (witness W1), rot 2 (moved to W2), dip 3
every counterexample of the KEL replay rules, and events without key 0 or with a wrong tag

next-key seeds and keys at seq 2, 3, 4; a RecoveryBlob under a fixed passphrase, salt and nonce (wrong passphrase, changed AID header); a RecoveryBlob of kdf local under a fixed local key and nonce (each mode opened as the other, wrong local key)
the KEL-2A hub as witness signs a notice for the tip of KEL-2B: NoticeBody, NoticeWire; a counterexample for each step of notice verification
PreimageV2 bytes and signature for every relayauth action (fed_* included); retired actions refused
the session MAC input and output; the receiving side of a session key delivery (fixed skR, recorded enc and ct)
the directory hash h and box key K; a box under a fixed nonce; opening it; a wrong AID does not open it
DelegateReq with keys 3 and 6 retired (present: decoding fails)
ChatMsg as a preview frame (keys 11-13) and as plain text (keys 4-7 or 11-13 present: decoding fails)
ResultResp key 6 reply (other keys in the reply: decoding fails)
CardGet; CardResp with card and with error
$files in args; the three private contexts; the request CID changes with a file CID

ix and requester commitments, settle guard; ReceiptBody and ReceiptWire; a ReceiptBody signature moved onto a payment Authorization fails; (ix, nonce) = ("a\u0000b", "c") and ("a", "b\u0000c") refused by the commitment and by PayBind
ReviewBody and ReviewWire; ReviewAttBody; the review tag
leaf and node hashes; a tree of 16 leaves; path verification; a path that moves a sum fails
the PoW seed; the PoW hash; a nonce with 22 leading zero bits and one with 21
the ael anet.supply.epoch record (VersionMajor2): bytes and signature

CapList; InvokeReq (local and relay; key 4 retired; key 5 caller); InvokeResp; every Refusal code; negatives (via 2, via 0 with aid, unknown key, duplicate map key, CBOR tag, invalid UTF-8); the two copies are byte for byte the same
the JSON frame of every p2p op; a frame with v = 2 refused; a dack of 107 characters

the local AEAD and MAC keys derived from ix_dek; field ciphertexts and aad under a fixed key and nonce, one per encrypted column, and their negatives (delivered by FS); client key and client digest (with the number literals 9007199254740992 and 9007199254740993, 1 and 1.0), still to be added to the same file by CUX

vectors.owner: CORE, SS, DLV, FS, KEL, HPP, CUX
vectors.covers: request and response of every hub endpoint; the error body of every hub reason; X-ANet-Wire negotiation; an AID with U+0000 answered 400 bad_request

org_id; the OrgCredBody and CogUnitBody preimages and signatures; negatives (no key 0, a tag one character off, the two signatures swapped, either signature over the inner preimage, a ReceiptBody or a payment Authorization)

the local A2A error shape: the a2a-go JSON-RPC and REST clients each recognize the standard error of no_local_task, extended_card_not_offered, extended_card_not_configured, extended_card_unavailable and message_id_reused; data or details is an array whose first item has domain a2a-protocol.org and whose second is anet's
the conformance identity every signed vector is anchored to; regenerated under KEL v2
